---
name: Closing a gap
about: You worked out something we have marked UNKNOWN or VERIFY
title: '[GAP] '
labels: 'gap-closed'
---

**Which gap**
Which item from `docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`, or quote the UNKNOWN / VERIFY line.

**What you found**
The value, size, part number, temperature, or whatever it turned out to be.

**How you know**
Measured it? Read it off a label or datasheet? Worked it out from the CAD? Or is it what you
chose and it works? All of those are useful — we just want to record which, the same way the rest
of the project does.

**Anything else**
Photos of a label are especially welcome.
